text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before the Yasuda Kinen, Tokai Teio stops by to offer encouragement and make an announcement while she's at it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to make a comeback before the end of spring and to run in the autumn Tenno Sho, fulfilling her promise to Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Yasuda Kinen arrives at long last, and we have more opponents to watch out for than Daiichi Ruby and Daitaku Helios alone…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus—an Umamusume who has honed her skills over the course of an impressive racing schedule—is also running today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Zephyr is calm. To continue moving forward alongside Teio, she's going to draw everything into herself and run like the ultimate wind!
